HAND SCALE / Lots, texts, names & numbers

Kledonomancy.

Reading chance words, overheard phrases or incidental speech as symbolic prompts.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Kledonomancy
Cledonomancia

Divinatory interpretation of an incidental utterance or overheard words.

Cledonomancy
Cledonomancia

An alternative English spelling of kledonomancy.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Pausanias describes an oracle of Hermes at Pharae involving the first words heard after a ritual inquiry. That account is one named historical setting rather than a rule for all incidental speech.

Hand scaleHuman scale

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Write the question and the selection rule beforehand.
  2. Record the exact phrase and immediate setting without searching for a more convenient one.
  3. Keep a literal transcription alongside the symbolic reading.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Submit a dated transcription with the context summarized.
  • Exclude private conversations and identify quotations only when permission or publication allows it.
